product.name: Screening Alerts
product.description: Automates investigation of alerts from existing screening systems to quickly close clear false positives.

product.name: Transaction Monitoring Alerts
product.description: Automates review of transaction monitoring alerts with the rigor of a senior transaction monitoring analyst.

product.name: Customer Due Diligence
product.description: Reviews customer documentation, financial statements, and web presence to identify risky new customers.

product.name: Enhanced Due Diligence
product.description: Automates and accelerates reviews of high-risk customers with improved analysis.

product.name: Business Enrichment
product.description: Provides automated insights into business customers, including employee count, addresses, and social media profiles.

product.name: Individual Enrichment
product.description: Enhances understanding of individual customers by automatically gathering relevant data without friction.
